title: MemoryBrief
description: The synthesized recall artifact returned by hybrid recall. NOT chunks; guidance. The model receives stable claims, context-specific preferences, active tensions, recent changes, and explicit unknowns — not raw text fragments. SKELETON: detailed in pr-1.4/memory-brief.

active_orbs.description: Orbs activated for this recall, ordered by activation strength.

context_specific.description: Branch-orb claims relevant to the current scope (e.g. 'in review contexts, prefer brutal depth').

active_tensions.description: Known unresolved contradictions surfaced for the model to handle, not flatten.

recent_changes.description: Consolidation events that affected the surfaced orbs in the last N cycles.

do_not_assume.description: Open questions and explicit unknowns the model should not fabricate around.

recall_reasons.description: Per-orb explanation of why it was surfaced (vector hits + graph traversals). The provenance of the recall itself.
